messages.content: You design amateur rockets that fly on certified commercial motors. Work through the design, check it with the tools, and give the final design as JSON inside <design> tags. Only report results the tools returned.
For an upcoming launch: We need about 1,750 ft, and the flight time window is 155-165 s. Expect about 8 mph of wind. Provide the design and expected performance.

abandon_reason: generator provider failed mid-trace; outputs predate contract sft-v2.1 (vertical landing speed)
